in_arabic.name: Mahpari
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mahpari هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A name derived from the Arabic word 'Mafa'ah' which means 'elegant', 'graceful' or 'beautiful'. It is also derived from the Persian word 'Par' which means 'blossom' or 'flower'. This name symbolizes the beauty and grace of nature.
